subject: Pilot rendezvous: kickoff calendar, success criteria & owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@tideshift.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot rendezvous: kickoff calendar, success criteria & owners

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed cadence so we can get the pilot moving next week. I attached a one‑pager with the proposed success criteria (TideShift_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx). Please confirm or flag edits.

High-level proposed timeline
- Kickoff: Wed, 6 Oct 2026 — 60min (technical + success criteria alignment)
- Week 1–4: Technical validation and integration (weekly 30min check-in, Wed)
- Week 5: Performance/quality run and tuning
- Week 6: Final readout and decision meeting (60min)

Proposed success criteria (candidate list — we can prioritize)
1) Functional: end‑to‑end inference on the sample dataset with expected label fidelity (baseline pass rate >= 85%)
2) Performance: 95th pct latency for 1k token prompt under steady traffic < 300ms (p95)
3) Cost: projected per‑request token cost within 15% of Redwood estimate in the POC cost model
4) Reliability: no more than 1% error rate across test corpus during a 24h stress window

Immediate next steps (please confirm owners/responsibilities)
- Customer: share a representative sample dataset (anonymized) and SSO/contact for procurement (Sanjay/Priya) — due Fri, 2 Oct
- Redwood AE (me): finalize mutual action plan (MAP) and share calendar invites for kickoff — due Mon, 4 Oct
- Redwood CSM (Monica): prepare onboarding checklist and request for API keys/test accounts — will schedule invite
- Redwood SE (Ben): prepare staging runbook and test harness, demo scripts for performance testing — will provide draft before kickoff

Notes / constraints you mentioned on the call
- Data residency: TideShift prefers US-only hosting during the pilot (confirm VPC option)
- Procurement: procurement@tideshift.com will need a short SOW + invoice cadence

If this looks good I’ll lock in Oct 6 for kickoff and Monica will send the invite. Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@tideshift.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@tideshift.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot rendezvous: kickoff calendar, success criteria & owners

Thanks Vivek — that recap is very helpful and aligned with our internal expectations. A few notes from our side:

- Kickoff: Oct 6 works for Priya and me; please schedule.
- Success criteria: we agree on the functional and cost buckets. Two additions we want to lock in:
  • Data handling confirmation (US-only, no backups outside region during the pilot).
  • Eval metric: p95 latency < 300ms for 1k token prompt (matches your note).
- Priorities: for the first 2 weeks we want integration + correctness; performance can be run in parallel weeks 3–5.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@tideshift.com for SOW/PO; they’ll want a short statement of work and an estimated invoice schedule.

Attaching our internal priority doc (TideShift_Eval_Priorities.pdf) showing dataset slices and their relative weight for the pass/fail threshold.

Action items from us:
- I will share an anonymized 10k‑row sample by Friday (Priya will take point).
- Procurement will provide PO window details after kickoff (contact: procurement@tideshift.com).

If you can send the MAP and invite I’ll confirm attendees on our side. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, TideShift
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Prep items for kickoff (please upload/share before Mon, Oct 4):
- Representative dataset (anonymized) — Priya
- Any existing inference logs or run examples you want us to mirror — optional

4) Next steps: API keys, sample jobs, and validation windows (10m)

Ben — can you share a very short staging checklist prior to kickoff so TideShift can provision any whitelisted IPs / test accounts?

Thanks — Monica
